title: transcripts/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl
description: One de-identified Tutoring Provider C transcript per line, unique on `transcript_id`. Text-only transcription executed by the provider: no video, no audio, no screen recording. A session is the dialogue plus the text of the problem the tutor was to work through. Every row also satisfies `transcript_core.schema.json`.

transcript_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the transcript. Primary key; annotations and moments join on it.

source.description: The provider this transcript came from; matches the file name.

batch.description: Partner delivery this transcript came from. Provider C delivered once, so this is always `"2026-07-06"`.

has_video.description: Whether the partner provided a recording of the session. Recordings are not released. Provider C provided none.

turns.description: Ordered dialogue turns. `turn_number` is the order authority.

session.description: Surrogate identifiers for the session and its participants. Also carries the student's program.

problems.description: The slides the tutor was to work through, in presentation order.

turn_number.description: 1-indexed position in the transcript. Annotations refer to turns by this number.

start_seconds.description: Offset of the turn's start, in seconds. Measured from the session's first turn. Provider C gives no end time.

role.description: The speaker. `Unattributed` is speech the transcription assigned to neither participant.

text.description: What the speaker said. De-identified with surrogate names; names that are part of problem content (e.g. a word problem) may be left unchanged to match the problem text.

Session.description: Surrogate identifiers for the session and its participants. Also carries the student's program.

session_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's session ID. Joins to `assessments/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `session_id`.

tutor_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's tutor ID. Stable across this tutor's sessions.

student_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's student ID. Stable across this student's sessions. Joins to `assessments/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `student_id`.

program_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the program: the block of sessions the student was enrolled in. Joins to `assessments/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `program_id`, where the pre- and post-program assessments for this program sit. Use it rather than `student_id` to pair sessions with those assessments: some students have more than one program.

Problem.description: Provider C shared slides of the curriculum the student and tutor were schedueld to work through during the tutoring session. The problem text is a written description of the math content on the slide..

slide_position.description: 1-indexed position of the slide within its objective's deck.

learning_objective.description: The curriculum objective this slide belongs to. Repeated on every slide sharing an `id`.

problem_text.description: Prose description of what the slide showed, generated from the slide image using gemini-3-flash-preview. Identical on every entry sharing a `slide_id`; absent, never empty, where there is no description.

id.description: Partner identifier for the objective. Same ID space as `assessments/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `questions[].lesson_id`.

examples: Adding money using the column method.

year.description: UK school year of the objective. Subtract one for the US grade (e.g. UK Year 2 = US Grade 1).
